articles.summary: Topline Phase 3 Results from C-FORWARD Expected Around Year-End 2026 More Than 880 HCV Treatment-Naïve Patients Enrolled Across 17 Countries Outside North America C-FORWARD and C-BEYOND Represent the First Global Phase 3 Head-to-Head Trials of Direct-Acting Antivirals for the Treatment of HCV
articles.title: Atea Pharmaceuticals Completes Patient Enrollment in Phase 3 C-FORWARD Trial Evaluating Bemnifosbuvir and Ruzasvir for Treatment of Hepatitis C Virus
